top_findings.description: The fixed switch centers provide 2.20 mm body clearance, not 1.00 mm.
The visual 8 mm estimate must not be represented as measured fit evidence.
Affected requirements need their own 2026-08-28 Change Notes.
Pre-implementation requirements need code addition-site traces and a pre-implementation status.
Strain-relief and RF/power test conditions need deterministic criteria.
